agent-note:v1
- task: 13637 (queue repo-health-code-pilot), lane code-j
- stage: done — design decision recorded and landed

The decision record for this design is written and merged to main: doc/2026-11-08_decision_id5874_thread_resolution.md via PR #7848 (merge 8f79a40162b521e3d295729e8a366927066e8b68).

Decision summary:
- Resolved-into is a signed event (chat.resolution.v1: kinds edit / decision / no-action), folded by projection — never a mutable flag on the thread. Both navigation directions come from the one derived edge set.
- Change proposals are signed events (chat.proposal.v1) carrying full proposed content by blob link, pinned to (object, base revision). Lifecycle (accepted / rejected / superseded / withdrawn) is derived from citing events; acceptance IS the accepting edit event citing the proposal — no separate approval write, no second permission system (only object writers can accept, because acceptance is an edit).
- Visibility: the parent #5682 no-leak rule applied through the note_links query-time access-filtering mechanism (edge dropped whole). Six implementation invariants, rejected alternatives, and the implementation split are in the record (sections 5, 6, 8).
- Not re-decided: #5682 parent decisions, #5870 anchors, #5871 talk-page semantics.

Follow-on: implementation is tracked in issue #7849 (timing a separate prioritisation decision, per this issue). Per this issue's closing rule — close the design with a recorded decision in a doc/ record linked from the issue — this design issue is now closed.
